item.title: Kuroshio Extension warming shaped by Gulf Stream variability via the Arctic atmosphere
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02139-2

Variability in the Gulf Stream influences Kuroshio sea surface temperatures through a hemispheric atmospheric circulation response explaining 13% of internal variability and contributing to recent North Pacific warming, according to model simulations.
